<br><br>


::: {#hero-heading}

I am a bioinformatics scientist with 25+ years of experience building computational infrastructure for genomics and biomedical research. My expertise spans Bayesian statistics, machine learning, variant calling, and epigenomics. Beyond individual research, I'm committed to mentoring collaborators, developing open-source tools, and modernizing scientific computing through reproducible workflows. I believe accessible, well-designed computational systems amplify the impact of collaborative research.

[Learn more about me &rarr;](/about){.about-links .subtitle}

:::
